title: Senior WHO official dodges questions about Taiwan’s WHO membership; praises China
summary: A short news clip of WHO official Bruce Aylward's 2020 interview with a Hong Kong outlet, in which he stalls and then ends the call when asked about Taiwan's WHO membership. He also says he would want to be treated in China if infected.
why: Cited, almost always critically, as evidence of Chinese influence over the WHO during the Covid pandemic.
